verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a mobile developer tool, so reviewing pull requests from a phone is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence shows Blink itself offering any pull-request listing, diff review, or commenting. Its ability to connect to VS Code for web or GitHub Codespaces, and to SSH or Mosh into remote machines, only gives access to other platforms' tools or to a user's own git setup. Those are host-platform capabilities and user workarounds, which earn no credit here.
